summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K reporting unaudited Q2 2026 results via press release. The filing covers routine quarterly financials: net profit USD 364.4 million, EBITDA USD 552.8 million, and a USD 0.64 per share distribution intention. It also notes vessel sales and charter agreements as ordinary operational items. This is a standard earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situations transaction. No merger, tender offer, strategic review, activist campaign, or other corporate event is announced.
